free_tier.stated: 2 GB storage on Free, 250 GB Standard, unlimited Premium

tooling: Jira Cloud REST API v3 issue attachments (multipart POST /rest/api/3/issue/{key}/attachments); jira-python wraps it
chaining: 2 GB x unlimited free sites; same math as Confluence but with the same 2 GB ceiling and a smaller default file cap
limits_note: 2 GB site cap; default attachment max 10 MB unless raised by an admin; every attachment needs an issue to hang off
reliability_note: identical bucket economics to Confluence Free — only worth it if you are already farming Atlassian sites; issue-per-attachment bookkeeping is worse than Confluence pages

evidence.proved: '2 GB of storage' (Free), '250 GB of storage' (Standard), 'Unlimited storage' (Premium)
